Maria (AE): Heads-up — customer 'HarborPay' wants a short POC showing parity with CompetitorX. Main asks: request/response mapping, token billing differences, and KMS for PCI data. Can we scope this week? :eyes:
Jake (Solutions Engineer): I can take the POC lead. Quick questions: do they need exact prompt=>response parity or functional parity? CompetitorX has a slightly different streaming chunking behavior that affects live chat UIs.
Maria (AE): They're worried about user-visible deltas — legal said 'no regressions for top-50 prompts'. So we need deterministic-ish outputs for those. Also pricing: they asked about per-token equivalence and surge limits.
Jake (Solutions Engineer): For top-50 prompts we can: 1) pin model version, 2) add a prompt-normalization shim, 3) run N=3 sampling and pick best-match heuristic for high-sensitivity flows. Suggest we demo: compatibility shim + compare diffs on sample set.
Sam (SRE): On infra: for the POC we can run on Dedicated pool with a small reserved set. Need to confirm throughput targets — what's their expected QPS? Also note streaming latency differences if we enable batching.
Maria (AE): HarborPay target is ~5 QPS peak but <100ms p95 for chat. They're sensitive to billing spikes during bursts.
Jake (Solutions Engineer): Okay. For parity testing I'll create a smoke script that hits both CompetitorX and Redwood endpoints with identical prompts and logs token counts and response diffs. Example curl for Redwood hosted API (placeholder):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"rw-1-large","input":"{PROMPT}"}'
```
Jake (Solutions Engineer): We'll also capture per-response token usage so we can show billed tokens delta. If CompetitorX counts tokens differently (e.g., different tokenizer or including metadata), we'll surface that in the report.
Ashley (Security): KMS/PCI: HarborPay requires envelope encryption of PII before leaving their VPC, plus audit logs. For Redwood Private we can do customer-managed keys (KMIP/HSM) and provide the key rotation policy doc. Need them to sign an NDA and confirm SOC2/ISO artifacts they need.
Maria (AE): They asked whether we can demonstrate KMS in the POC without handing over keys — can we do a whitebox demo?
Sam (SRE): We can stand up a Private deployment in their VPC with our control plane disabled and BYOK through their KMS. That sample will show end-to-end encryption without us holding keys. For hosted demo, we can simulate same flow with a mock KMS and explicit note it's not production.
Jake (Solutions Engineer): Action items: 1) I'll spin up the comparative test harness and draft the prompt-normalizer (Jake). 2) Sam will confirm Dedicated pool sizing and provide latency expectations (Sam). 3) Ashley will attach the KMS/crypto checklist and questionnaire answers (Ashley). 4) Maria will get the signed NDA and top-50 prompt set from HarborPay (Maria).
Maria (AE): Timeline — can we have an initial demo + report by EOD Friday?
Sam (SRE): Tight but doable if we get the prompt set and keys mock today. I'll reserve a small node and disable aggressive batching to hit the p95 target for chat.
Jake (Solutions Engineer): I'll prioritize the harness and will post a short perms script and sample diff output in this thread when ready.
Ashley (Security): I'll upload the KMS one-pager and our SOC2 summary. Also will flag that they may need an ATO for on-prem deployment.
deploy-bot: Deployment queued: dedicated-poc-harborpay (small) — ETA 22m
Maria (AE): Thanks team. I'll ping HarborPay for the NDA and prompt set now. If we hit blockers I'll escalate. :thumbsup:
Jake (Solutions Engineer): FYI — potential blocker: CompetitorX uses a custom post-processing reranker that changes final text. If their top-50 prompts rely on that, parity may require reimplementing the reranker or offering an adapter. I'll enumerate differences in the tech report.
Maria (AE): Good call. Add that as a risk in the slide deck.
Sam (SRE): Noted. Also: make sure to include token-billing reconciliation steps and an example reconciliation script for finance.
Jake (Solutions Engineer): Will do. I'll share the first smoke run and diff summary in ~4 hours.
Maria (AE): Perfect — standups 11:30 PT to align.
Ashley (Security): One more ask from Legal: can we confirm data retention windows for POC logs? We'll provide a 7-day auto-delete policy for POC logs unless they request otherwise.
Maria (AE): Adding to the checklist. Thanks everyone.
